incident_text: A brick building partly collapsed after the earthquake. Bricks are lying across the street.

result.scene_summary: A heavily damaged brick building with collapsed sections and debris on the street, surrounded by traffic lights and street signs, with modern skyscrapers in the background.

observations.description: Significant damage to a multi-story brick building with exposed wooden framing and collapsed sections.
A pile of rubble and broken bricks on the street.
Street lights, traffic signals, and a traffic cone are visible on the street.
